nodes.summary: Holder of String constants naming idempotency-guarded operations such as CREATE_PROGRAM_ORDER and PROGRAM_CACHE_REVERSE_MQ.

nodes.name: DelayOrderCancelDto.java
nodes.summary: DTO carrying the order number for delayed order-cancel messages delivered through the delay queue.

nodes.name: DelayOrderCancelDto
nodes.summary: Simple DTO with the orderNumber field used by the delayed order cancel producer/consumer.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderCreateDto.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for creating a program ticket order: program id, user id, ticket buyer ids, and either explicit seats or ticket category plus count.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderCreateDto
nodes.summary: Order creation parameter object supporting both designated-seat and category/count purchase modes.

nodes.name: SeatDto.java
nodes.summary: DTO describing a single seat purchase request with id, ticket category, row/column codes, seat type and price.

nodes.name: SeatDto
nodes.summary: Serializable seat purchase parameter used inside ProgramOrderCreateDto.

nodes.name: SeatVo.java
nodes.summary: View object for seat data returned to callers, including program, ticket category, position, price and sell status.

nodes.name: SeatVo
nodes.summary: Serializable seat view model cached in Redis and exchanged between program and order services.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing V1-V4 program order creation endpoints, each dispatching to the matching versioned order strategy via ProgramOrderContext.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderController
nodes.summary: Spring REST controller with four versioned create endpoints resolving strategies from ProgramOrderContext by ProgramOrderVersion.

nodes.name: createV1
nodes.summary: Creates a program order using the V1 baseline strategy (database lock oriented).

nodes.name: createV2
nodes.summary: Creates a program order using the V2 strategy combining local and distributed locks.

nodes.name: createV3
nodes.summary: Creates a program order using the V3 strategy with local locks and synchronous Redis cache-resolution updates.

nodes.name: createV4
nodes.summary: Creates a program order using the V4 strategy with local locks and asynchronous MQ-based order creation.

nodes.name: LockTask.java
nodes.summary: Functional interface representing a task executed while holding local ReentrantLocks during order creation.

nodes.name: LockTask
nodes.summary: Single-method callback interface with execute() invoked inside the locked region by BaseProgramOrder.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderService.java
nodes.summary: Core service implementing program order creation: seat and stock validation, atomic Redis Lua cache updates, order creation via RPC or Kafka, delayed cancel scheduling, and cache rollback on failure.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderService
nodes.summary: Spring service orchestrating high-concurrency ticket ordering across cache, RPC and MQ paths with compensation logic.

nodes.name: getTicketCategoryList
nodes.summary: Resolves and validates the ticket categories involved in an order against multi-level cached category data.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Validates seats, stock and prices for an order, performs the Redis cache-resolution update, then creates the order via the RPC path.

nodes.name: createOrderOperateProgramCacheResolution
nodes.summary: Builds Redis keys and JSON payloads and executes the create-order Lua script to atomically deduct stock and lock seats in cache.

nodes.name: doCreate
nodes.summary: Builds order parameters, creates the order via RPC and schedules a delayed order-cancel message.

nodes.name: doCreateV2
nodes.summary: Builds order parameters, creates the order via Kafka message and schedules a delayed order-cancel message.

nodes.name: buildCreateOrderParam
nodes.summary: Assembles the OrderCreateDto with program details, total price, order number from the UID generator, and per-ticket-user seat entries.

nodes.name: createOrderByRpc
nodes.summary: Creates the order through the OrderClient RPC; rolls back the program cache when the remote call fails.

nodes.name: createOrderByMq
nodes.summary: Sends the create-order message to Kafka and blocks on a CountDownLatch until the send callback confirms, rolling back the cache on failure or timeout.

nodes.name: updateProgramCacheDataResolution
nodes.summary: Restores or locks Redis stock and seat caches depending on order status (NO_PAY vs CANCEL) through the cache-resolution Lua operator.

nodes.name: AbstractProgramCheckHandler.java

nodes.name: AbstractProgramCheckHandler
nodes.summary: Base class tying program order check handlers into the composite execution framework under the PROGRAM_ORDER_CREATE_CHECK type.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderCreateParamCheckHandler.java
nodes.summary: Composite handler validating program order creation parameters: duplicate ticket buyers, seat/ticket-user count match, and mandatory seat or category fields.

nodes.name: ProgramOrderCreateParamCheckHandler
nodes.summary: Concrete composite check handler throwing DaMaiFrameException on any invalid order creation parameter combination.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Runs the full parameter validation sequence for a program order creation request, covering both designated-seat and category/count modes.

nodes.name: CreateOrderMqDomain.java
nodes.summary: Domain object capturing the outcome (order number or exception) of an asynchronous create-order Kafka send.

nodes.name: CreateOrderMqDomain
nodes.summary: Holds the orderNumber and an optional DaMaiFrameException produced during async order message sending.

nodes.name: CreateOrderSend.java
nodes.summary: Kafka producer component sending create-order messages to a configured topic with success/failure callback notification.

nodes.name: CreateOrderSend
nodes.summary: Spring component wrapping KafkaTemplate.send with a CompletableFuture callback dispatching to SuccessCallback/FailureCallback.

nodes.name: sendMessage
nodes.summary: Sends the serialized order message to the environment-prefixed Kafka topic and routes the async result to the given callbacks.
